linesZhTw: 堆敵人集結在這小小的冰島
linesZhCn: 堆敌人集结在这小小的冰岛
linesEn: Just as I suspected.
To see so many enemies gathered on this tiny frozen island... they must be plotting something.

linesZhTw: 黑暗戰士和沒見過的傢伙呢
聲勢似乎頗為浩大的樣子！
linesZhCn: 黑暗战士和没见过的家伙呢
声势似乎颇为浩大的样子！
linesEn: Let me take a look... Whoa!
Beastmen, Dark Warriors, and even creatures I've never laid eyes on!
They certainly make quite an imposing force!
Lady Mitty... what should we do now?

linesZhTw: 事情就可以告一段落了！』
linesZhCn: 事情就可以告一段落了！』
linesEn: Isn't it obvious?!
We wipe them all out, and that'll put an end to this!

linesZhTw: 法…總勝於站在這裡發呆吧
linesZhCn: 法…总胜于站在这里发呆吧
linesEn: Is that so? Well, I agree with Thor.
It's certainly better than just standing here twiddling our thumbs!

linesZhTw: 這裡，不就是要把事情弄清
linesZhCn: 这里，不就是要把事情弄清
linesEn: You're right!
We didn't travel all this way just to turn back without getting to the bottom of it!
Look out! The enemy has spotted us!

linesZhTw: 我知道這幾天來妳一直在調
查此地的事…唔，看來妳還
linesZhCn: 我知道这几天来你一直在调

linesEn: Sword Master Mitty, is it? You've finally arrived.
I know you've been snooping around these parts for days...

linesZhTw: 帶了不少陪葬的傢伙，這一
來這冰島上可有得熱鬧了…
linesZhCn: 带了不少陪葬的家伙，这一
来这冰岛上可有得热闹了…
linesEn: And it looks like you brought plenty of friends to be buried with you.
This frozen rock is about to get very lively...
Lady Mitty, is that bizarre creature the mastermind behind all this?

linesZhTw: 形怪狀的模樣，我感覺得到
他身上有強大的魔力……總
linesZhCn: 形怪状的模样，我感觉得到
他身上有强大的魔力……总
linesEn: Most likely, yes.
Don't let his grotesque appearance fool you. I can feel immense magical power radiating from him...

linesZhTw: 之，這是個棘手的強敵，索
linesZhCn: 之，这是个棘手的强敌，索
linesEn: In short, he is a dangerous foe.
Thor, be on your guard!
Hmph! I'm not afraid of this freak!
Charge, everyone!

linesZhTw: 和你們聊聊的，只好早點送
你們下地獄了…給我殺個片
linesZhCn: 和你们聊聊的，只好早点送
你们下地狱了…给我杀个片
linesEn: Such uncouth brutes.
I had hoped to chat a while, but it seems I'll just have to send you to hell early...
Slaughter them all! Leave none alive!
Lady Mitty! We hope we're not too late!

linesZhTw: 大，請各位盡力作戰，我們
linesZhCn: 大，请各位尽力作战，我们
linesEn: You arrived just in time!
The enemy is formidable. Fight with everything you have—victory must be ours!
Understood! We won't let you down, my lady!

linesZhTw: 我的修練還是不夠…剩下的
linesZhCn: 我的修练还是不够…剩下的
linesEn: Ah... The power of darkness is formidable indeed...
My training was not enough... I must leave the rest to you...
How... How could mere wretched humans strike me down...?
Master... save me...

linesZhTw: 寶石？原來是在冰魔神的
linesZhCn: 宝石？原来是在冰魔神的
linesEn: Wait! Could this be... the 'Eye of Ice' gem?
So the Ice Demon God had it all along...
You know about the Demon Eye Gems?

linesZhTw: 傳說以來，就一直在追尋
其中的秘密。但為什麼這
linesZhCn: 传说以来，就一直在追寻

linesEn: Yes. Ever since I learned of an ancient legend, I've been seeking the secrets behind them.

linesZhTw: 些傢伙會擁有其中之一？
linesZhCn: 些家伙会拥有其中之一？
linesEn: Yet why would these fiends possess one of them...?

linesZhTw: 前唯一可以肯定的是，這
絕對不會是什麼好事…嗯
linesZhCn: 前唯一可以肯定的是，这
绝对不会是什么好事…嗯
linesEn: We are looking into that as well.
The only certainty right now is that it bodes nothing good...

linesZhTw: 這件事還是等打完仗再來
linesZhCn: 这件事还是等打完仗再来
linesEn: Still, we had better finish this battle before discussing it further...
Fair enough.
Besides, victory is already within our grasp!

linesEn: Their true objective remains an utter mystery.
It looks like we still have a long road ahead of us...
Will you continue to journey with me to track down these villains?

linesZhTw: 者約拿，請他醫治悠妮小姐
linesZhCn: 者约拿，请他医治悠妮小姐

linesEn: Jonah? Why, he's the one who initiated this entire investigation!
He reached out across the continent of Mara to summon skilled warriors and heroes...

Did you truly not know about this?

黑森林与他会合，但他并没
有说明原因……现在我总算
linesEn: Jonah did ask me to meet him in the Black Forest to the north, but he never explained why...
Now I finally understand!
Hey there, lads!
Are you the ones who defeated the Ice Demon God?

linesZhTw: 『原來我們打倒的傢伙叫做冰
魔神，看來和你們上次救出
國王時遇到的地魔神是一夥

魔神，看来和你们上次救出

linesEn: So that creature we defeated was called the Ice Demon God.

linesZhCn: 的。他们真正的目的究竟为
linesEn: Their true objective remains an utter mystery...
Lady Mitty, what do you plan to do next?

linesZhTw: 有多麼危險，你們現在應該
很清楚了，如果愛惜性命的
linesZhCn: 有多么危险，你们现在应该
很清楚了，如果爱惜性命的
linesEn: Continue digging into the enemy's true identity.
By now, you should all understand just how perilous this path is.

linesZhTw: 賽可邦德，他們就交給你了
時間緊迫，我得先走一步
linesZhCn: 赛可邦德，他们就交给你了
时间紧迫，我得先走一步
linesEn: If you value your lives, it's best you stop here.
Sekobang, I leave them in your care. Time is short, so I must go on ahead...
Farewell...

linesZhTw: 是從哪裡跑出來的？和冰魔
linesZhCn: 是从哪里跑出来的？和冰魔
linesEn: Is there any doubt?
By the way, where did you come from? Are you with the Ice Demon God?

linesZhTw: 凱拉斯，奉命前來冰島調查
時不小心中了這些雜碎的奸
linesZhCn: 凯拉斯，奉命前来冰岛调查
时不小心中了这些杂碎的奸
linesEn: Don't misunderstand! I am Kailas, a Dragonute swordsman.
I was ordered to investigate this island, but I fell into a trap set by those scoundrels...

linesZhCn: 计，一直被关在地下的冰穴

linesEn: They locked me in an underground ice cavern.
I only managed to wriggle free of my bonds and escape just moments ago.

linesZhTw: 『冰魔神和其部下確實已被我
們打倒了，我想你可以放心
linesZhCn: 『冰魔神和其部下确实已被我
们打倒了，我想你可以放心
linesEn: The Ice Demon God and his minions have indeed been defeated.
You can rest easy now.

linesZhTw: 真是一件了不起的成就……
不過你們為何要與他們作對
linesZhCn: 真是一件了不起的成就……
不过你们为何要与他们作对
linesEn: Is that so? Defeating the Ice Demon God is no small feat...
Still, what reason do you have to fight them?
Why cross swords with such foes?

linesZhTw: 大陸各地胡作非為，我們的
目的雖然是尋找賢者約拿，
linesZhCn: 大陆各地胡作非为，我们的
目的虽然是寻找贤者约拿，
linesEn: Who needs a reason?! Those villains have been wreaking havoc across the continent.
Our goal was originally to find Sage Jonah...

linesZhTw: 但是看到他們的種種惡行，
linesZhCn: 但是看到他们的种种恶行，
linesEn: ...but seeing their vile deeds, how could we just stand by and do nothing?

linesZhTw: 但因此交了不少朋友，戰技
也大為提昇，而約拿恰巧也
linesZhCn: 但因此交了不少朋友，战技
也大为提升，而约拿恰巧也
linesEn: Fighting enemies along the way has brought us many allies and sharpened our martial skills.
And as it turns out, Jonah has been investigating this matter too...

linesZhTw: 在調查此事，我們的方向正
linesZhCn: 在调查此事，我们的方向正
linesEn: So our journey happens to align perfectly with his.

linesZhTw: 斯也受到約拿之邀出面調查
此事，因此他與我分頭前往
linesZhCn: 斯也受到约拿之邀出面调查
此事，因此他与我分头前往
linesEn: I see...
Our king, St. Colas, was also asked by Jonah to investigate this crisis.

linesZhTw: 冰島和西方的沙漠，想查明

敌人的底细，结果我没料到
敌人大军聚集于此，一下子
linesEn: He and I split up—one to the western desert and one to this frozen island—to uncover the enemy's secrets.
I never expected them to amass such an army here...
...and I ended up captured before I knew what hit me.

linesZhTw: 『聖寇拉斯陛下竟然也親自出

linesZhCn: 『圣寇拉斯陛下竟然也亲自出
马了，看来事态一定非同小
linesEn: King St. Colas moved out in person?
The situation must be dire indeed.

期早過了，也不知道接下來
linesZhCn: 被关了这么多天，约定的日
期早过了，也不知道接下来
linesEn: Indeed! But I have failed His Majesty's trust.
Trapped here for days, I've long missed our rendezvous date...
I have no idea what I should do next...

linesZhTw: 『那你乾脆加入我們一行好了
反正陛下遲早也會和賢者約

linesZhCn: 『那你干脆加入我们一行好了
反正陛下迟早也会和贤者约
拿会合，和我们一起去找约
linesEn: Why not join us, then?
His Majesty will surely meet up with Sage Jonah sooner or later.

linesZhTw: 拿，不是也一樣可以找到陛
linesZhCn: 拿，不是也一样可以找到陛
linesEn: If you come with us to find Jonah, you'll be reunited with the King just the same!
You make a good point.
Though I wonder what the rest of your companions think...

linesZhTw: 然目的一致，我們當然歡迎
linesZhCn: 然目的一致，我们当然欢迎
linesEn: Dragonute warriors are honorable fighters.
Since we share the same goal, we gladly welcome you to our ranks!

linesZhTw: 帳以後再和敵人清算就好了
linesZhCn: 帐以后再和敌人清算就好了
linesEn: That's right! There's no shame in being captured.
We'll settle that score with the enemy later!
My deepest thanks to you all!
I am Kailas the swordsman. I look forward to fighting by your side!

linesZhTw: 不過，我可不想繼續待在這
個光禿禿的冰島上，索菲亞
linesZhCn: 不过，我可不想继续待在这
个光秃秃的冰岛上，索菲亚
linesEn: Excellent! Another ally joins the fray!
Still, I don't want to linger on this barren frozen rock any longer.
Sophia, where do we head next?
We should head further north through the mountain pass toward the Sweet Plains...

linesZhTw: 的人不多，想必往後的旅程
linesZhCn: 的人不多，想必往后的旅程
linesEn: That mountain pass is quite secluded—very few folk know about it.
The rest of our journey should be nice and peaceful, I imagine.
Hahaha!
Let's hope so.
Let's move out!
